title: Network hallucination generates symmetric protein assemblies confirmed by structure
summary: Deep-network hallucination generated symmetric homo-oligomers from protomer number and length; crystal structures of seven designs matched models (median RMSD 0.6 angstrom) and three cryo-EM structures of giant rings up to C33 symmetry were obtained. Abstract-level review only.

evidence.tested: Seven crystal and three cryo-EM structures compared with models.
evidence.unknown: Fraction of failed designs not read; full text not read.
evidence.ai_role: Predictor-driven hallucination produced new backbones and sequences.
